purpose: Schema of one extension manifest (modules/extensions/<name>.json shipped, local/extensions/<name>.json owner's), id socratex-extension/v1
x-rules: name equals the file name without .json and is lower-case letters, digits and hyphens
when_to_use is one sentence on one line, at most 200 characters
source has a locator: url, path (a local file or folder of this repo) or id; with url or id it also has commit or version (the value 'unknown' is allowed and means not pinned yet)
kind ref: source.url (https) and source.commit (40 hex characters or 'unknown'), no install, default_enabled false
kind install: a non-empty install list of command strings; they run only with `sox ext install <name> --yes`, after a backup
ledger is the id of the matching entry in docs/IMPROVEMENTS.json
